title: Castle of Magic
notes: Clean IPA SHA-256 6cf0dfdd91534f19e58c06ea577dbb7aa4d6fd4cf915f654fa98c8df270f4f44. On a physical POCO X3 ARM64 phone, English selection, Play Game, New Game, the intro and Green Labyrinth opened. Holding right moved the hero and collected a gem (10 to 11); holding left moved him back. The owner separately reports that the game works excellently. This short independent check does not verify jump/attack, audible sound, pause, save/reload, sustained play or true widescreen, so the catalogue remains partial rather than claiming a fully verified game.
